record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set maxlen=64, num_blocks=4, dropout=0.3 and learning rate=7e-4; preserve hidden width 64, kernel size 3 and existing dilation scheduling. Four two-convolution blocks with dilations 1,2,4,8 cover 61 positions, exceeding each dataset's 95th-percentile history length. The shorter window and shallower network reduce computation, while stronger dropout and a lower learning rate may improve generalization and stability. Preserve loss, features, embedding tying, scoring and readout; retain seed 42, 200 batches per epoch and the 200-epoch cap, with matching predictor metadata.

Increase dropout to 0.3 and lower learning rate to 7e-4 to test stronger regularization and steadier optimization with reduced computation.
